title: What is your shipping policy?
content: We ship nationwide within 2-3 business days. Orders are processed on business days only. If you need details by city or faster delivery options, please tell us your location.

title: What is your return policy?
content: Returns are accepted within 7 days if the product is unopened and in original condition. If your case is different, please share the order date and product condition so we can advise.

title: How do I take care of my dog or cat?
content: Basic pet care includes proper nutrition, vaccination schedule, hygiene, and regular health checks. For tailored advice, please share your pet's age, weight, and current condition.

title: How should I choose food for my pet?
content: Choose food based on age, species, and health needs. If your pet has digestive issues or allergies, consider specialized diets and share the symptoms for better guidance.

title: What is the vaccination schedule for pets?
content: Vaccination schedules depend on age and previous shots. Please provide your pet's age and vaccination history for a specific recommendation.

title: How can I contact the store?
content: We can share business hours, hotline, address, social channels, and support methods. Please tell us which details you need.

title: What promotions are available right now?
content: Promotions are updated regularly. Please tell us the category you want (food, toys, health care) so we can share the most relevant offers.
